articles.title_en: Early life determinants of social disparities among young adults: A longitudinal study in vulnerable communities in South Africa
articles.title_cn: 南非弱势社区年轻人社会差距的早期生活决定因素：一项纵向研究
articles.abstract_en: South Africa has achieved major poverty reductions in the post-Apartheid era, but substantial variations in progress between population groups have been documented, and inequalities between poor Black communities and other parts of South Africa persist. Similarly, life chances and inter-generational mobility vary with proximal early life economic environments. The long-term interrelationships of different aspects of these environments are not well understood.
articles.abstract_cn: 南非在后种族隔离时代实现了大幅减贫，但不同人口群体之间的进展差异已被记录，贫困黑人社区与南非其他地区之间的不平等持续存在。同样，生活机会和代际流动性随早期生活经济环境的不同而变化。这些环境不同方面的长期相互关系尚未得到充分理解。

articles.title_en: One for all and all for one: Increasing the adaptive capacity of households and communities through a public work programme
articles.title_cn: 人人为我，我为人人：通过公共工作计划提高家庭和社区的适应能力
articles.abstract_en: This article uncovers the mechanisms shaping the impact of the public work component of Ethiopia’s Productive Safety Net Programme (PSNP) on beneficiaries and communities’ food security and vulnerability to various shocks. Using three waves of a national representative household survey, this study provides quantitative evidence on the pathways through which the social protection intervention affects direct beneficiaries and their community peers. The empirical findings show that the PSNP beneficiaries are less likely to be food insecure and to experience harvest losses in the aftermath of droughts. Notably, the beneficial effects of the programme partially spill over to the direct participants’ community peers. This is likely to be due the nature of the public works implemented through the programme, such as the integrated community-based watershed development, including soil and water conservation measures and rangeland management in pastoral areas. Additionally, no significant impacts have been found when households self-report stresses unrelated to droughts. Our findings are expected to inform the debate on the effectiveness of the PSNP and other adaptive social protection programmes. From a policy perspective, they suggest the explicit integration of environmental and climate considerations into the design of social protection interventions targeting poor agricultural households highly vulnerable and exposed to weather shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文揭示了埃塞俄比亚生产安全网计划（PSNP）的公共工作组成部分对受益者及社区粮食安全和各种冲击脆弱性影响的机制。利用三轮全国代表性住户调查，本研究提供了关于社会保护干预如何影响直接受益者及其社区同伴的路径的定量证据。实证发现表明，PSNP受益者在干旱后更不可能面临粮食不安全或经历收成损失。值得注意的是，该计划的有益效应部分溢出到直接参与者的社区同伴。这可能是由于通过该计划实施的公共工程的性质，例如综合社区流域开发，包括水土保持措施和牧区牧场管理。此外，当家庭自我报告与干旱无关的压力时，未发现显著影响。我们的发现预计将为关于PSNP和其他适应性社会保护计划有效性的辩论提供信息。从政策角度看，它们表明在设计针对高度脆弱且暴露于天气冲击的贫困农业家庭的社会保护干预措施时，应明确纳入环境和气候考量。

articles.title_en: Statebuilding and indigenous rights implementation: Political incentives, social movement pressure, and autonomy policy in Central America
articles.title_cn: 国家建设与土著权利实施：政治激励、社会运动压力与中美洲的自治政策
articles.abstract_en: What explains when states strengthen, maintain, or erode political-territorial Indigenous autonomy regimes? Indigenous activists around the world have fought for the right to govern their own lands and communities and have sometimes won major legal concessions from national governments. Yet initial breakthroughs often give way to lackluster state implementation or even erosion of Indigenous autonomy rights. We examine how statebuilding incentives structure governments’ implementation of autonomy, drawing on cases in Central America. Under some circumstances government officials may perceive Indigenous autonomy regimes as the best option to promote state influence over otherwise difficult-to-reach territories and populations. Autonomy regimes may improve governability, for example, in regions where criminal organizations or other armed actors operate. Autonomy regimes may also lead Indigenous peoples to increasingly identify themselves with the national state. Finally, autonomy regimes may further integrate Indigenous communities into markets by creating property relations and consultation mechanisms that defuse Indigenous opposition to extractive projects. When these statebuilding incentives to advance governability, identification, and extraction are absent, however, government officials are more likely to erode autonomy regimes. Through comparisons of the trajectories of Indigenous autonomy regimes in Honduras, Panama, and Nicaragua, we show how these statebuilding concerns shaped state policies towards Indigenous autonomy across governments’ ideologies and regime types. Our findings highlight the importance of examining social movements’ practical consequences, and how aligning movement demands with statebuilding interests may shape whether gains can be defended and sustained, an especially pressing concern for Indigenous movements facing extractive projects, land invasions, and climate change.
articles.abstract_cn: 什么解释了国家何时加强、维持或削弱政治-领土土著自治制度？世界各地的土著活动家为争取管理自己土地和社区的权利而斗争，有时从国家政府那里赢得了重大的法律让步。然而，最初的突破往往让位于国家实施不力甚至土著自治权利的削弱。我们考察了国家建设激励如何构建政府对自治的实施，借鉴中美洲的案例。在某些情况下，政府官员可能认为土著自治制度是促进国家对难以触及的领土和人口施加影响的最佳选择。自治制度可以提高可治理性，例如，在犯罪组织或其他武装行为体活动的地区。自治制度也可能使土著人民越来越多地认同国家。最后，自治制度可能通过创建财产关系和协商机制，化解土著对采掘项目的反对，从而进一步将土著社区融入市场。然而，当这些促进可治理性、认同和采掘的国家建设激励缺失时，政府官员更可能削弱自治制度。通过对洪都拉斯、巴拿马和尼加拉瓜土著自治制度轨迹的比较，我们展示了这些国家建设关切如何在不同政府意识形态和政权类型下塑造了国家对土著自治的政策。我们的发现强调了审视社会运动实际后果的重要性，以及将运动诉求与国家建设利益对齐如何可能影响成果能否被捍卫和维持，这对于面临采掘项目、土地侵占和气候变化的土著运动来说是一个尤为紧迫的问题。

articles.title_en: Knowledge protects against pollution: The health effects of the cadmium rice event in China
articles.title_cn: 知识抵御污染：中国镉大米事件的健康效应
articles.abstract_en: The paper studies the effects of news media coverage of the 2013 cadmium rice event in China on consumer health outcomes and avoidance behavior. A difference-in-differences analysis shows that the event caused a 2% decrease in the incidence of joint or muscle pain (JMP), a major health outcome of cadmium pollution, in high-cadmium-pollution regions relative to other regions. Individuals with higher income or with more access to traditional TV media or digital media experienced a greater level of JMP reduction. To defend against cadmium pollution, residents in cadmium-polluted regions switched their drinking water from unsafe sources such as surface water to the safe source of deep groundwater and significantly reduced their consumption of rice. Our findings demonstrate the importance of information provision as an informal approach to complement formal environmental regulation and the critical role of news media in environmental regulation and public health.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了2013年中国镉大米事件的新闻媒体报道对消费者健康结果和规避行为的影响。双重差分分析表明，该事件导致高镉污染地区相对于其他地区的关节或肌肉疼痛（JMP）发病率下降了2%，而JMP是镉污染的一个主要健康结果。收入较高或更多接触传统电视媒体或数字媒体的个体，其JMP减少幅度更大。为抵御镉污染，镉污染地区的居民将饮用水从地表水等不安全水源转向深层地下水这一安全水源，并显著减少了稻米消费。我们的研究结果表明，信息提供作为正式环境监管的非正式补充手段具有重要意义，且新闻媒体在环境监管和公共卫生中发挥着关键作用。

articles.title_en: How Natural Resources Affect Corruption in China
articles.title_cn: 自然资源如何影响中国的腐败
articles.abstract_en: This study explores the effect of natural resource production on the corruption of local public officials in China. We introduce a novel, micro-level data set on the production of three major fuel resources in China—oil, natural gas, and coal (2000–2005)—and analyze alongside county-level statistics and individual-level survey data. Our analyses show that the effects of resource extraction on corruption vary substantially depending on the type of natural resources exploited. We find that coal production alone is robustly associated with corruption among local public officials in county governments. Moreover, citizens in coal-producing areas are more likely to perceive government officials as corrupt. We posit that the coal industry’s regulation-heavy and labor-intensive production process along with smaller firm sizes are the primary sources of this effect. Our findings suggest effective tackling of resource-related corruption requires careful attention to the type of resources and their link to local political economy.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了自然资源生产对中国地方公职人员腐败的影响。我们引入了一个新颖的微观层面数据集，涵盖中国三种主要燃料资源——石油、天然气和煤炭（2000-2005年）的生产情况，并结合县级统计数据和个体层面调查数据进行分析。我们的分析表明，资源开采对腐败的影响因所开采的自然资源类型而有显著差异。我们发现，仅煤炭生产就与县级政府地方公职人员的腐败密切相关。此外，煤炭产区居民更倾向于认为政府官员腐败。我们认为，煤炭行业监管密集、劳动密集的生产过程以及较小的企业规模是这一影响的主要来源。我们的研究结果表明，有效解决资源相关腐败问题需要密切关注资源类型及其与地方政治经济的联系。

articles.title_en: Cofinancing and infrastructure project outcomes in Chinese lending and overseas development finance
articles.title_cn: 共同融资与中国贷款及海外发展融资中的基础设施项目成果
articles.abstract_en: Cofinancing from government agencies, development banks, and private actors is acknowledged as an important tool to bridge the infrastructure finance gap in developing countries, but relatively little is known about outcomes for cofinanced projects. To fill this void, we explore the role of cofinancing in shaping Chinese lending and overseas development finance for infrastructure projects in terms of implementation outcomes and environmental performance. We examine a sample of 2997 infrastructure projects committed between 2000 and 2017 that were funded by Chinese finance, among which 15 percent are cofinanced. Our study shows that cofinancing correlates with higher infrastructure project completion rates, as cofinanced projects are 3.3–7.1 percentage points less likely to be cancelled or suspended than non-cofinanced ones. We also find that cofinancing with certain partners suggests specific benefits. Cofinancing with partners from the recipient country is associated with more localized implementation, whereas cofinancing with international partners has demonstrated improved environmental performance, with a 2.7 percent lower carbon dioxide emissions intensity and a 0.42 standard deviation decrease in biodiversity risks. The results suggest that cofinancing could be an effective tool to enhance infrastructure project success and achieve greater sustainable performance in Chinese lending and overseas development finance.
articles.abstract_cn: 来自政府机构、开发银行和私人行为者的共同融资被认为是弥合发展中国家基础设施融资缺口的重要工具，但关于共同融资项目成果的了解相对较少。为填补这一空白，我们探讨了共同融资在塑造中国贷款及海外发展融资基础设施项目的实施成果和环境绩效方面的作用。我们考察了2000年至2017年间由中国融资资助的2997个基础设施项目样本，其中15%为共同融资项目。我们的研究表明，共同融资与更高的基础设施项目完成率相关，共同融资项目被取消或暂停的可能性比非共同融资项目低3.3-7.1个百分点。我们还发现，与特定伙伴的共同融资暗示了具体的好处。与东道国伙伴的共同融资与更本地化的实施相关，而与国际伙伴的共同融资则显示出改善的环境绩效，二氧化碳排放强度降低2.7%，生物多样性风险降低0.42个标准差。结果表明，共同融资可能是提升基础设施项目成功率并在中国贷款及海外发展融资中实现更可持续绩效的有效工具。

articles.title_en: Is there a virtuous cycle between wages and productivity? Turkish experience after the transition to democracy
articles.title_cn: 工资与生产率之间存在良性循环吗？民主转型后的土耳其经验
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the behavior of plant-level real wages and productivity in Turkish manufacturing after the transition to democracy in 1987 and test for the direction of the causality between these two variables. The Turkish experience is almost an experimental case because successive governments after 1987 let real wages increase rapidly under the pressure of intensifying political competition. Real wages in state-owned enterprises increased by nearly 200% from 1988 to 1993, followed by a 130% increase in real wages in private manufacturing. Our analysis shows that labor and total factor productivity increased at an unprecedented rate during the same period in response to the exogenous wage hikes. Econometric estimates provide strong empirical evidence supporting the hypothesis that there is a bi-directional relationship between wages and productivity, and wage increases do not reduce surplus because the increase in productivity (value added per worker) compensates for increasing wages.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了土耳其制造业在1987年民主转型后工厂层面实际工资和生产率的行为，并检验了这两个变量之间因果关系的方向。土耳其的经验几乎是一个实验性案例，因为1987年后的历届政府在日益激烈的政治竞争压力下，使实际工资迅速增长。国有企业实际工资从1988年到1993年增长了近200%，随后私营制造业实际工资增长了130%。我们的分析表明，在同一时期，劳动生产率和全要素生产率以空前的速度增长，以应对外生工资上涨。计量经济学估计提供了强有力的经验证据，支持工资与生产率之间存在双向关系的假设，并且工资增长不会减少剩余，因为生产率（人均增加值）的增长补偿了工资的增长。

articles.title_en: Not all supply chains are created equal: The linkages between soy local trade relations and development outcomes in Brazil
articles.title_cn: 并非所有供应链都是平等的：巴西大豆地方贸易关系与发展结果之间的联系
articles.abstract_en: Global agricultural trade is a key driver of socioenvironmental transformations in rural areas, including development dynamics. By creating revenue and wealth opportunities, it influences the economic and social relations in a landscape. However, not all landscapes shaped by a given agricultural sector are the same: one variable is how supply chain actors and their embedded networks (including commodity traders, farmers, and input suppliers) develop, maintain, or shift relationship patterns over time. To explore the connections between development and the nature of such trade relationships, particularly between farmers and commodity traders, we take soy as an emblematic example and compare four different municipalities in Brazil. The contrasting cases are Passo Fundo (RS), an old soy-growing area in Brazil’s South, in a consolidated agricultural region with relatively persistent relationships between farmers and commodity traders; Sorriso (MT), in a more recently occupied agricultural region in the country’s Center-West, with relatively low persistence of supply-chain relations; Balsas (MA), a place with persistent supply-chain relations in the so-called Matopiba agricultural expansion frontier; and Bom Jesus (PI), also a frontier municipality but having less persistent relations. We build on quantitative assessments of supply-chain stickiness in those four municipalities, which is understood as the persistence of those commercial relationships in contrast to volatility. Analyzing qualitative data collected through over 30 field interviews with local actors, we show how soy supply-chain relations significantly differ across places. We distinguish them particularly in terms of lock-in effects on farmers and level of trust. Crucially, our findings identify supplier cooperatives as key mediating institutions in the supply chain, counterbalancing the power of commodity traders over farmers. Such cooperatives are also associated with more equitable development outcomes. Yet, they require high levels of social trust and distribute wealth primarily within the sector, leaving other farmers excluded.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球农业贸易是农村地区社会环境转型（包括发展动态）的关键驱动力。通过创造收入和财富机会，它影响着景观中的经济和社会关系。然而，并非所有由特定农业部门塑造的景观都是相同的：一个变量是供应链参与者及其嵌入网络（包括商品贸易商、农民和投入品供应商）如何随时间发展、维持或转变关系模式。为了探索发展与此类贸易关系性质之间的联系，特别是农民与商品贸易商之间的关系，我们以大豆为例，比较了巴西的四个不同城市。对比案例包括帕苏丰杜（南里奥格兰德州），这是巴西南部的一个老牌大豆种植区，位于一个农业发达地区，农民与商品贸易商之间的关系相对持久；索里索（马托格罗索州），位于该国中西部一个较新开发的农业区，供应链关系的持续性相对较低；巴尔萨斯（马拉尼昂州），在所谓的马托皮巴农业扩张前沿地区，供应链关系持久；以及邦热苏斯（皮奥伊州），也是一个前沿城市，但关系持续性较低。我们基于这四个城市供应链粘性的定量评估，该粘性被理解为这些商业关系的持久性与波动性的对比。通过分析对当地参与者进行的超过30次实地访谈所收集的定性数据，我们展示了大豆供应链关系在不同地方存在显著差异。我们特别从对农民的锁定效应和信任水平方面进行区分。至关重要的是，我们的研究结果将供应商合作社确定为供应链中的关键中介机构，平衡了商品贸易商对农民的影响力。此类合作社还与更公平的发展结果相关。然而，它们需要高度的社会信任，并且主要在部门内分配财富，使其他农民被排除在外。

articles.title_en: The politics of tied aid: Technology transfer and the maintenance and repair of water infrastructure
articles.title_cn: 捆绑援助的政治：技术转让与供水基础设施的维护和修复
articles.abstract_en: In many African countries, international donor funding schemes contribute significantly to financing water infrastructures, especially for constructing new networks and water plants and upgrading existing ones. However, little is known about how these financial arrangements shape infrastructure maintenance and repair. This article explores the politics of tied water aid to show how international donors’ technology transfer schemes and their associated funding conditionalities shape water infrastructure maintenance and repair. Empirically, this study builds on a qualitative study of the cities of Accra (Ghana) and Dar es Salaam (Tanzania), where the maintenance and repair of water infrastructures have been a persistent challenge. The article shows that the compulsory adoption of foreign technologies embedded in donors’ funding schemes limits local capacity to properly maintain and repair water infrastructure. As maintenance and repair increasingly depend on imported expert knowledge, spare parts, and engineering services, donors’ funding schemes undermine effective maintenance and repair in both cities. We argue that to make transferred water technologies work sustainably in recipient countries, funding schemes need to anticipate maintenance and repair by incorporating local capacity building and knowledge transfer to reduce import dependence.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多非洲国家，国际捐助者的资助计划对供水基础设施的融资贡献显著，尤其是用于建设新管网和水厂以及升级现有设施。然而，关于这些财务安排如何影响基础设施的维护和修复，人们知之甚少。本文探讨了捆绑供水援助的政治，以展示国际捐助者的技术转让计划及其相关的资助条件如何影响供水基础设施的维护和修复。在实证方面，本研究基于对阿克拉（加纳）和达累斯萨拉姆（坦桑尼亚）两座城市的定性研究，这两座城市的供水基础设施维护和修复一直是一个持续的挑战。文章表明，捐助者资助计划中强制采用外国技术限制了当地妥善维护和修复供水基础设施的能力。随着维护和修复日益依赖进口的专业知识、备件和工程服务，捐助者的资助计划削弱了这两座城市的有效维护和修复。我们认为，为了使转让的供水技术在受援国可持续地发挥作用，资助计划需要通过纳入当地能力建设和知识转移来预见维护和修复需求，以减少进口依赖。

articles.title_en: Socioeconomic conditions and contagion dynamics of the COVID-19 pandemic with and without mitigation measures: Evidence from 185 countries
articles.title_cn: 社会经济条件与COVID-19大流行的传染动态及缓解措施：来自185个国家的证据
articles.abstract_en: It is well documented that COVID-19 contagion and mortality rates differed systematically across countries. Less is known, however, on whether these differences could be explained by socioeconomic conditions that may determine both the extent to which individuals voluntarily take protection measures in the absence of Non-Pharmaceutical Interventions (NPIs) or comply with imposed NPIs, when these are in place. Using data from 185 countries, we examine associations of COVID-19 infection and mortality dynamics with socioeconomic conditions, as measured by poverty rates, in periods before and after NPIs have been imposed. We find that, in the initial period of the pandemic, when no NPIs were in place, daily growth of COVID-19 cases and deaths are positively associated with the share of the population living in poverty, whereas, in the following period, when NPIs were implemented, these associations turn negative. We argue that these results could be explained by the fact that NPIs are expected to be more effective in countries with high poverty rates where voluntary physical distancing is low and physical distancing practices are more responsive to imposed measures.
articles.abstract_cn: 已有充分文献记载，COVID-19的传染率和死亡率在不同国家之间存在系统性差异。然而，关于这些差异是否可由社会经济条件解释，我们知之甚少。社会经济条件可能决定个体在无非药物干预措施（NPIs）情况下自愿采取防护措施的程度，或在实施NPIs时遵守强制措施的程度。利用185个国家的数据，我们考察了COVID-19感染和死亡动态与以贫困率衡量的社会经济条件之间的关联，分别考察NPIs实施前后的时期。我们发现，在大流行初期，当未实施NPIs时，COVID-19病例和死亡的日增长率与生活在贫困中的人口比例呈正相关，而在随后实施NPIs的时期，这些关联转为负相关。我们认为，这些结果可能解释为：在贫困率高的国家，自愿保持身体距离的程度较低，而身体距离实践对强制措施的反应更为敏感，因此NPIs在这些国家预期更为有效。

articles.title_en: Using registry data to assess gender-differentiated land and credit market effects of urban land policy reform: Evidence from Lesotho
articles.title_cn: 利用登记数据评估城市土地政策改革对性别差异化的土地和信贷市场影响：来自莱索托的证据
articles.abstract_en: While well-defined urban property rights to support land and financial markets are widely considered to be essential for economic development, many studies using household-based data to study titling programs’ impact yield inconclusive results. We use a 2010–13 titling program in Maseru to argue that this may partly be attributable to a failure of using administrative data and the fact that impacts of policy change that affect treatment and control are not identified in a standard difference in differences (DID) approach. Registry data show significant and sustained changes in quality of service delivery; female land ownership; and volume of registered land sales and mortgages due to the project. Econometric analysis supports this and points to significant effects of regulatory reform. We use this as a basis to discuss ways of combining registry and household survey data to better analyze this type of interventions.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管明确的城市产权以支持土地和金融市场被广泛认为对经济发展至关重要，但许多使用基于住户数据研究土地确权项目影响的研究结果并不确定。我们利用马塞卢2010-13年的确权项目来论证，这在一定程度上可能归因于未能使用行政数据，以及影响处理组和对照组的政策变化的影响在标准双重差分（DID）方法中未被识别。登记数据显示，项目带来了服务质量、女性土地所有权以及注册土地销售和抵押贷款数量的显著且持续的变化。计量经济学分析支持这一点，并指出监管改革的显著影响。我们以此为基础，讨论如何结合登记数据和住户调查数据以更好地分析这类干预措施。

articles.title_en: Short- and long-term food insecurity and policy responses in pandemics: Panel data evidence from COVID-19 in low- and middle-income countries
articles.title_cn: 大流行中的短期与长期粮食不安全及政策应对：来自低收入和中等收入国家COVID-19的面板数据证据
articles.abstract_en: We leverage unique panel household phone survey data collected by the World Food Programme (WFP) several months before and 3 years into the COVID-19 pandemic in nine low-and middle-income countries to examine whether the COVID-19 period was associated with increases in food insecurity. We also combine this data with data from the Oxford COVID-19 response tracker to examine how lockdown policies and economic support policies to households have affected food consumption.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用世界粮食计划署（WFP）在COVID-19大流行前几个月及之后3年收集的九个低收入和中等收入国家的独特家庭面板电话调查数据，考察COVID-19时期是否与粮食不安全加剧相关。我们还将这些数据与牛津COVID-19应对追踪器的数据相结合，研究封锁政策和对家庭的经济支持政策如何影响食品消费。

articles.title_en: Beyond Deforestation Reductions: Public Disclosure, Land-Use Change and Commodity Sourcing
articles.title_cn: 超越减少毁林：公开披露、土地利用变化与商品采购
articles.abstract_en: Global commodity supply chains contribute significantly to environmental degradation and greenhouse gas emissions. Improving supply chain transparency can create public awareness and encourage relevant actors to improve their ecological footprint. We exploit Brazil’s Priority List policy for the Amazon region, a public disclosure mechanism introduced in 2008 that effectively reduced deforestation rates, to study how land users and commodity traders respond to the corresponding reputational risk exposure. Specifically, we combine remotely sensed land use data with spatio-temporally disaggregated soy trade statistics covering 15 years and 770 municipalities to measure the effect of priority listing on land-use change, sourcing patterns, and trade destinations. Using the Generalized Synthetic Control method, we find that priority listing led to a sizeable drop in deforestation and a corresponding reduction in pasture expansion. At the same time, soy expansion increased significantly, but instead of expanding into natural forests, it mostly replaced existing pastures and other cropland. The additional soy production was exported predominantly to China, whereas exports to the EU stagnated.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球商品供应链显著加剧了环境退化和温室气体排放。提高供应链透明度可以增强公众意识，并鼓励相关行为者改善其生态足迹。我们利用巴西针对亚马逊地区的优先名单政策——一项于2008年引入的公开披露机制，有效降低了毁林率——来研究土地使用者和大宗商品交易商如何应对相应的声誉风险暴露。具体而言，我们将遥感土地利用数据与覆盖15年和770个市镇的空间-时间分解大豆贸易统计相结合，以衡量优先名单对土地利用变化、采购模式和贸易目的地的影响。使用广义合成控制方法，我们发现优先名单导致毁林大幅下降，相应的牧场扩张也减少。与此同时，大豆扩张显著增加，但并未扩展到天然森林，而是主要取代了现有牧场和其他农田。额外的大豆生产主要出口到中国，而对欧盟的出口则停滞不前。

articles.title_en: The role of trainings in improving supplier sustainability performance
articles.title_cn: 培训在提升供应商可持续性绩效中的作用
articles.abstract_en: This article analyses the impact of training measures on supplier sustainability performance. It raises the question of the role that training measures and knowledge sharing activities by focal firms play in improving sustainability performance in a global supplier network. The analysis is based on a difference-in-difference approach with multiple time periods following Callaway & Sant’Anna (2021), using a longitudinal data set of over 5000 first-tier suppliers from the automotive industry. We find that sustainability trainings improve supplier sustainability performance in general. Specifically, these results seem to be driven by longer training sessions that require active supplier engagement, outlining a clear learning objective and relating to local sustainability challenges.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了培训措施对供应商可持续性绩效的影响。文章提出了焦点企业在全球供应商网络中通过培训措施和知识共享活动在改善可持续性绩效方面所起作用的问题。分析基于Callaway & Sant’Anna（2021）提出的多时期双重差分方法，使用了来自汽车行业超过5000家一级供应商的纵向数据集。我们发现，可持续性培训总体上改善了供应商的可持续性绩效。具体而言，这些结果似乎是由要求供应商积极参与、明确学习目标并涉及当地可持续性挑战的较长培训课程所驱动的。

articles.title_en: Unconditional cash transfers and safe transitions to adulthood in Malawi
articles.title_cn: 无条件现金转移与马拉维青年向成年的安全过渡
articles.abstract_en: As national social safety nets are expanding in Africa and globally, evidence on the impact of programs on youth transitions can help guide future investment and program design decisions. This paper examines the effects of Malawi’s flagship cash transfer program on safe transitions to adulthood among youth living in households experiencing ultra-poverty. The evaluation was a cluster-randomized control trial implemented over three years using panel data on youth aged 13 to 19 at baseline. Household receipt of bi-monthly transfers led to improvements in four out of six outcome domains: 1) education, 2) physical health, 3) emotional wellbeing and mental health, and 4) sexual and reproductive health. There were limited or no impacts on outcomes related to HIV risk and time use. Results imply that similar programs in the region may also facilitate safe youth transitions. Nonetheless, more intentional gender- and youth-specific designs may have promise for more holistic impacts, and further evidence is needed on longer-term effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着非洲及全球范围内国家社会安全网的扩展，关于项目对青年过渡影响的证据有助于指导未来的投资和项目设计决策。本文考察了马拉维旗舰现金转移项目对生活在极端贫困家庭中青年向成年安全过渡的影响。评估采用整群随机对照试验，历时三年，使用基线时年龄在13至19岁之间的青年面板数据。家庭每两个月收到一次转移支付，导致六个结果领域中的四个得到改善：1）教育，2）身体健康，3）情感福祉和心理健康，以及4）性健康和生殖健康。与HIV风险和时间使用相关的结果影响有限或没有影响。结果表明，该地区的类似项目也可能促进青年的安全过渡。尽管如此，更有针对性的性别和青年特定设计可能有望产生更全面的影响，并且需要进一步证据来评估长期效果。

articles.title_en: Long COVID: The evolution of household welfare in developing countries during the pandemic
articles.title_cn: 长期新冠：疫情期间发展中国家的家庭福利演变
articles.abstract_en: This study examines household welfare dynamics during the COVID-19 pandemic, using harmonized data from over 300 phone surveys in 80 countries during 2020 and 2021, representing more than 2.5 billion people. The analysis traces out the evolution of employment and income across and within countries as restrictions on economic activity were relaxed. We show some groups initially experiencing higher rates of employment loss – including women, informal workers, and those with less education – also recovered jobs at a slower pace. Based on panel regressions, changes in policy stringency were associated with unequal employment outcomes. Labor market transitions were toward jobs of inferior quality on average, especially for workers with less education. Household income dynamics suggest uneven impacts in the intensive margin of employment consistent with these transitions. Lower wages were not offset by additional social assistance. Taken together, these dynamics may amplify the inequality impacts of the pandemic over the medium to long term.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用19年和300年间在80个国家进行的2020多项电话调查的统一数据，考察了COVID-2021疫情期间的家庭福利动态，这些数据代表了超过2.5亿人口。分析追踪了随着经济活动限制放松，各国国内及国家间就业和收入的演变。我们显示，一些最初经历较高就业损失率的群体——包括女性、非正规工人和教育程度较低者——其就业恢复速度也较慢。基于面板回归，政策严格程度的变化与不平等的就业结果相关联。劳动力市场转型平均而言转向质量较低的工作，尤其是对教育程度较低的工人而言。家庭收入动态表明，与这些转型一致的就业强度边际影响不均。较低的工资并未被额外的社会援助所抵消。总体而言，这些动态可能在中期至长期内放大疫情对不平等的影响。

articles.title_en: Applying the six-dimensional food security framework to examine a fresh fruit and vegetable program implemented by self-help groups during the COVID-19 lockdown in India
articles.title_cn: 应用六维粮食安全框架考察印度COVID-19封锁期间自助团体实施的新鲜果蔬项目
articles.abstract_en: To alleviate impacts of novel coronavirus lockdowns on food security and agri-food value chains, governments implemented various policy responses, yet there is limited evidence as to their effectiveness to build resilience in food systems and improve food security. One of these programs was implemented by self-help groups (SHGs) in Odisha, India, linking fresh fruit and vegetable (FFV) producers to consumers. This study integrates the concept of resilience into the six-dimensional food security framework (food availability, access, utilization, and stability, agency, and sustainability) and applies the framework to examine whether a FFV procurement program affected all six dimensions of food security and helped build resilience in food systems. Based on qualitative data from semi-structured interviews and focus group discussions, the results show that by enabling SHGs to fulfill the role of value chain actors prohibited from operating during the lockdown, the program had positive effects on availability, accessibility, utilization, and stability, with mixed effects on agency and sustainability. Applying the six-dimensional food security framework allowed us to show that despite some tradeoffs both across and within the dimensions for various actors, overall the program was able to build more resilient food systems. Activating preexisting organizations to reestablish fractured value chains can provide a model to replicate in times of crisis, such as pandemics and extreme climate events, when both rural and urban value chain actors can operate only at limited capacity and the public sector is overwhelmed. To accelerate the transformation of food systems towards healthier diets and greater resilience to shocks and crises, we recommend strengthening existing and establishing new organizations to help respond to crises and future shocks. A multifaceted approach will help ensure that the most vulnerable will not be left behind.
articles.abstract_cn: 为减轻新型冠状病毒封锁对粮食安全和农业食品价值链的影响，政府实施了各种政策应对措施，但关于这些措施在增强粮食系统韧性和改善粮食安全方面的有效性的证据有限。其中一项计划由印度奥里萨邦的自助团体（SHGs）实施，将新鲜果蔬（FFV）生产者与消费者联系起来。本研究将韧性概念整合到六维粮食安全框架（粮食供应、获取、利用和稳定性、能动性和可持续性）中，并应用该框架考察FFV采购计划是否影响了粮食安全的全部六个维度，并有助于建立粮食系统的韧性。基于半结构化访谈和焦点小组讨论的定性数据，结果表明，通过使SHGs能够履行在封锁期间被禁止运营的价值链参与者的角色，该计划对供应、获取、利用和稳定性产生了积极影响，对能动性和可持续性的影响则好坏参半。应用六维粮食安全框架使我们能够表明，尽管各维度内部和之间对不同参与者存在一些权衡，但总体而言，该计划能够建立更具韧性的粮食系统。激活已有组织以重建断裂的价值链，可以为危机时期（如大流行病和极端气候事件）提供可复制的模式，此时城乡价值链参与者只能以有限能力运营，公共部门不堪重负。为加速粮食系统向更健康饮食和对冲击和危机更具韧性的转型，我们建议加强现有组织并建立新组织，以帮助应对危机和未来冲击。多方面的方法将有助于确保最脆弱群体不被落下。

articles.title_en: The impact of urban green business environment on FDI quality and its driving mechanism: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 城市绿色营商环境对外商直接投资质量的影响及其驱动机制：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: The world's leading recipient of foreign direct investment (FDI), China should pay attention to both the volume and quality of FDI as it seeks to integrate more fully into globalization. At this stage of development, establishing an environmentally friendly business environment has become a critical strategy for improving the quality of FDI. So, this paper constructs the index system of the urban green business environment and the measurement of FDI quality to test the driving mechanism of the urban green business environment on FDI quality. The study draws the following conclusions. Firstly, the green business environment can significantly enhance FDI quality, and this impact exhibits a positive spatial spillover effect overall. However, regionally, only the eastern region demonstrates a positive spillover effect. Secondly, the mechanism test results reveal that public services, financial services, market environment, ecological environment, human resources, and legal environment are the key driving factors of the urban green business environment on FDI quality. Moreover, the intermediary effect test establishes that the urban green business environment enhances FDI quality by mitigating risks. Thirdly, the heterogeneity test results indicate that the green business environment can enhance FDI quality for cities with varying income and pollution levels. The research results provide a new perspective for improving FDI quality and optimizing the green business environment. They hold significant implications for enlightening the coordinated development of the urban green business environment and FDI quality in different regions, as well as for maximizing the influence of the green business environment on FDI quality.
articles.abstract_cn: 作为全球最大的外商直接投资（FDI）接收国，中国在更全面地融入全球化的过程中，应同时关注FDI的数量和质量。在当前发展阶段，建立环境友好的营商环境已成为提高FDI质量的关键战略。因此，本文构建了城市绿色营商环境指标体系并测度了FDI质量，以检验城市绿色营商环境对FDI质量的驱动机制。研究得出以下结论。首先，绿色营商环境能够显著提升FDI质量，且这种影响总体上呈现正向空间溢出效应。然而，在区域层面，仅东部地区表现出正向溢出效应。其次，机制检验结果显示，公共服务、金融服务、市场环境、生态环境、人力资源和法律环境是城市绿色营商环境影响FDI质量的关键驱动因素。此外，中介效应检验证实，城市绿色营商环境通过降低风险来提升FDI质量。第三，异质性检验结果表明，对于不同收入水平和污染水平的城市，绿色营商环境均能提升FDI质量。研究结果为提高FDI质量和优化绿色营商环境提供了新视角。这对于启示不同地区城市绿色营商环境与FDI质量的协调发展，以及最大化绿色营商环境对FDI质量的影响具有重要意义。

articles.title_en: Contested firewood collection in Burkina Faso: Governance, perceptions, and practices
articles.title_cn: 布基纳法索有争议的薪柴采集：治理、认知与实践
articles.abstract_en: This qualitative study explores how forest governance is perceived and embodied in everyday firewood practices in two rural villages in Burkina Faso. The study specifically looks into women’s and forest guard’s perceptions of firewood collection, access to wood, and the state regulations in place. Such exploration is helpful for showing how women who rely on firewood for their livelihoods respond to and perceive regulations, the synthesizing efforts, and the environmental impacts of firewood collection. To situate the interrelations of forest institutions, perceptions, and practices, the study draws on a critical institutional and feminist political ecology approach. Such an approach sheds light on how firewood governance in Burkina Faso excludes women from deciding over a resource they rely on for everyday life. Moreover, the approach helped illuminate how management by control, monitoring, and sensitizing efforts have a questionable impact on deforestation in forest commons.
articles.abstract_cn: 这项定性研究探讨了布基纳法索两个农村村庄中森林治理如何被感知并体现在日常薪柴实践中。研究特别关注妇女和森林护林员对薪柴采集、木材获取以及现行国家法规的认知。这种探索有助于展示依赖薪柴为生的妇女如何回应和感知法规、综合努力以及薪柴采集的环境影响。为了定位森林制度、认知与实践之间的相互关系，研究借鉴了批判性制度主义和女性主义政治生态学方法。这种方法揭示了布基纳法索的薪柴治理如何将妇女排除在对她们日常生活所依赖资源的决策之外。此外，该方法有助于阐明通过控制、监测和宣传努力进行的管理对森林公地 deforestation 的影响是否具有可疑性。

articles.title_en: How do energy-saving policies improve environmental quality: Evidence from China’s Top 10,000 energy-consuming enterprises program
articles.abstract_en: Treating China’s Top 10,000 Energy-Consuming Enterprises Program (T10000P) as a quasi-natural experiment, this is the first study to investigate the synergistic effects of the representative energy-saving policy on environmental quality at the micro-level. We create a panel data set by matching China’s Environmental Statistics Database, Industrial Enterprise Database, and State Intellectual Property Office Database, and employ the difference-in-differences model to identify the policy’s environmental effects and their mechanisms. The results show that the T10000P can effectively lower chemical oxygen demand (COD) and sulfur dioxide (SO2) emissions, which still hold after a series of robustness checks, indicating that the policy has a significant synergistic effect on environmental quality improvement. Furthermore, compared with small polluters, the T10000P has a higher pollutant emission inhibition effect on large polluters. Such a positive environmental impact is confirmed for energy-intensive, large, rather than non-energy-intensive and small enterprises, showing heterogeneous effects across different enterprises. We also find that promoting green technology innovation and environmental compliance are the important channels through which the policy improves environmental quality. Therefore, the energy-saving policy can improve environmental quality by setting constrained targets on energy consumption, especially in developing countries.
